messages:
Amira: Kickoff — Wavelength Systems wants a 10-day co-hosted sandbox POC. Goals: demo low-latency chat, ingest their telemetry, and validate SSO + SCIM provisioning. They need static egress IPs for firewall allowlisting and a short ops runbook.

Kai: I can run partner coordination. Will gather SE list and domain contacts. Propose orientation Thu 9am PT.

Marta: I can spin up a multi-tenant sandbox cluster Mon/Tue. Need partner tenant ID, preferred CIDR, and whether they want VPC peering or outbound NAT only.

Priya: Security: they sent a questionnaire (reqs: SAML2, SP-initiated SSO, SCIM, and data residency notes). I'll pull our SOC2 cert and prepare attribute mapping. ETA: Wed EOD.

Ben: Eng: demo target ~100ms p99 for 128-token bursts. Multi-tenant should be fine for functional tests. If they want Dedicated, expect ~30% cost uplift. Rough uplift estimate for their expected 600 QPS peak ~ $150/day.

Diego: Commercial: for a short 10-day POC we can apply a 40% trial credit on Dedicated and include 8 hours of onboarding support. Need legal approval for the credit.

Amira: Notes: runbook template -> https://go.redwood.dev/runbooks/cohost-template. We should include SSO steps, SCIM calls, static egress CIDRs, and a rollback plan.

Marta: Partner provided CIDR 10.52.0.0/16 and SAML metadata (attached). I'll add to the runbook and start provisioning once the CIDR is confirmed.

Priya: Partner also asked about telemetry endpoints and IP ranges for telemetry ingestion. I'll request static egress blocks from infra and add allowlist entries.

Ben: FYI if they later request model weights to be colocated on-prem, that's a Private deployment discussion — different pricing and lead times. Tag Sales.

Diego: Drafting the commercial one-pager now, will post in #partnerships for review.

Amira: Action items:
- Kai: confirm partner SE list + send orientation invite (Thu 9am PT)
- Marta: provision multi-tenant sandbox after CIDR + tenant ID confirmed
- Priya: SOC2 + SAML attribute matrix by Wed EOD; request static egress from infra
- Ben: validate perf target in sandbox and produce fallback plan
- Diego: draft one-pager + escalate legal for trial credit approval

Amira: @redwood-deploy-bot please open an internal ticket to track provisioning + SAML intake.

redwood-deploy-bot: Created ticket INT-4721 for co-host sandbox provisioning and SAML intake. Assignee: Marta. ETA 48h.

Marta: Picking this up. I'll confirm with partner whether they prefer peering or NAT before provisioning. Also need partner SCIM admin contact to test user sync.

Kai: Orientation invite sent. Calendar link and dial-in posted in thread.

Priya: Uploaded SOC2 cover and started attribute mapping doc in the runbook. Will update when infra returns static egress ranges.

Ben: Will run a perf sweep after sandbox provisioning and post results.

Diego: Legal acked the credit request, pending final signoff.

Amira: Thanks team — target to have SSO + egress allowlist confirmed and sandbox ready before Thu orientation. Ping here for blockers. :thumbsup:
